title: Vaporesso Dojo Blast Fresh Prefilled Pod & Refill  – Matcha Strawberry
description: Refresh your Dojo Blast experience with the Matcha Strawberry Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack, designed for the Vaporesso Dojo Blast range. This innovative replacement pack uses Vaporesso's patented INSTA-JUICED technology, keeping the 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid safely sealed in the 10ml container until assembly to ensure ultimate freshness. Matcha Strawberry offers a unique, cafe-style pairing. It blends the sweet, summery notes of British Malling Centenary Strawberry with the earthy depth of Japanese Okumidori Matcha, all rounded out by a soft, milky finish. This sophisticated profile delivers a remarkably smooth and balanced vape. Each pod and refill pack is fully compatible with all Dojo Blast kits, offering up to 10,000 puffs* per pack. Powered by an advanced COREX BLAST dual-mesh coil, it guarantees consistently dense vapour and exceptional flavour reproduction. How to Set Up Your Dojo Blast Fresh Pod: Remove the 2ml pod and the 10ml refill container from the packaging. Remove the red silicone plug from the top of the 2ml empty pod. Slide the 10ml refill container securely into the 2ml pod to assemble the pack. Wait for exactly five minutes to allow the e-liquid to fully saturate the coil. Insert the assembled pack into your Dojo Blast device and inhale to vape. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
